units.source_text: 你们两地伤心，大家终日愁怀莫展，真好苦也！”

en.t: You are both grieving in separate places, and everyone spends the whole day weighed down with sorrow. How truly painful it is!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子每次向王命妇纠缠，总是不得成果，空手归去。

en.t: Whenever Prince Genji pressed O no Myobu, he always failed to gain any result and went back empty-handed.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子深恐他来的次数太多，

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo was deeply afraid that he was visiting too often,

units.source_text: 引人怀疑，因此对王命妇也不便再像从前那样亲近了。

en.t: which would make people suspicious, and so she could no longer treat O no Myobu as intimately as before.

units.source_text: 她生怕受人注目，并不明显地疏远她。

en.t: Fearing that she might attract attention, she did not distance herself from her in any obvious way.

units.source_text: 但有时回想起她的拉拢，也不免对她怀恨。

en.t: But at times, when she thought back on how O no Myobu had drawn them together, she could not help bearing resentment toward her.

units.source_text: 王命妇被她疏远，似觉出乎意外，心中好生没趣。

en.t: O no Myobu seemed surprised to be kept at a distance by her, and felt deeply disheartened.
